behavior: A touch outside an open popup closes it only when the touch is a tap: it ends with `pointerup` in less than 1 s, and it moves 10 px or less. A touch that scrolls the page ends with `pointercancel` and closes nothing, as a native popover stays open in Chromium and WebKit. A drag of more than 10 px closes nothing. In Base UI, a touch that scrolls the page closes a Popover, a Menu or a Select.
